adjudication.rationale: In the diff, GoogleCalendarService.createEvent now selects the target calendar via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` when not found. If a DestinationCalendar entry exists with a valid `externalId` but `credentialId` is null/undefined (legacy data), the `find` will not match and `calendarId` becomes `"primary"`, changing behavior from the previous implementation that used `destinationCalendar.externalId` directly. Additionally, CalendarManager.createEvent only passes `credential.id` into `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` and does not pass along the `externalId` argument it receives, so GoogleCalendarService has no other way to honor a legacy destination’s `externalId` when `credentialId` is missing.
